summary: Tested all 9 requested flows on test-user-pro / Model Vessel at 390x844 (UI and backend). All 9 PASS, and no functional bugs were found. (1) Quick Role Selection: quick-role-selection sits directly under the CREW ROLES / Change available row (y 384 vs 328-376) and above crew-role-group-0 (y 450). It is unchecked by default even with old localStorage mbp_role_briefing_prompt='0'. Unchecked, tapping MOB Spotter opened 'Role Briefing - MOB Spotter'. Once ticked, the help text turns red (rgb 220,38,38, bold), Grab Bag/Helmsman/Fender Manager are added with no pop-up, mbp_quick_role_selection='1' is saved, and it stays ticked after Done and reopening in the same session. role-briefing-toggle(-input) is gone. (2) Copy WhatsApp message: the toasts use sonner y=top, x=center at top 16-82px, and crew-invite-done-btn is far below (y 1377), so they don't overlap. (3) The invite made 'Crew Prep - TEST_210 Alpha' (19 items) with the toast '... made for the crew' at the top. The list on screen stayed Boat Inventory and the invite window stayed open. Re-inviting the same name made no duplicate (only one registry entry). Quick Invite of a registered TEST_210 Bravo made 'Crew Prep - TEST_210 Bravo' with both toasts at the top. (4) Crew window: crew-invite-<id>-preview-btn 'Preview Invite' comes after the rsvp 'No reply yet' in the same flex-wrap. It opens crew-invite-preview-dialog with 'TEST_210 Alpha will receive an invite...'. Pressing Join shows the role briefing (MOB Spotter). Not now / Escape goes back to the crew window. (5) reg-done-btn 'Done' closes crew-register-dialog and the crew window stays open. (6) Route Planning: route-crew-hops sits under route-hops with sky-100 Crew/Prep/Roles bubbles. Crew opens the crew window, Prep selects Crew Prep, and Roles selects Crew Roles with no 'Back to invite' bar. open-crew-status-btn and its old text are gone. Regression: Change available from the invite still shows Back to Invite crew. (7) Crew Prep: crewPrep-hop has only crewPrep-hop-route-btn (no crewPrep-hop-view) and goes back to Route Planning. crew-prep-clones lists one bubble per clone (light red bg rgb 254,242,242, User icon, no x). Tapping one opens that list. After Select All on Alpha's list, its bubble turned emerald (bg 236,253,245) with a circle-check, and Bravo stayed red. The Crew Roles list has tpl_9f5620bc49-hop-route-btn 'Route Planning', which goes back. (8) PrepBadge: crew-invite-<id>-prep read 'Crew Prep - TEST_210 Alpha: 19 of 19 ticked' as a green pill with a check. Bravo's 0 of 19 stayed plain sky text. (9) Crew Prep clone dialog: Alpha was disabled and checked as 'already made', Bravo (whose clone I removed) was selectable, and Clone list made it ('created from Crew Prep') and opened it. Backend: 3 pytest tests pass. Invites with walk_skip return it in GET /crew, invites without it have no key and no _id, and prep progress is attached. All TEST_210 data was cleaned up.

issues: With a medium-length name (e.g. 'TEST_210 Alpha'), the Preview Invite bubble wraps onto its own line under 'No reply yet' rather than sitting next to it. It is still in order, but consider a shorter label or a smaller gap if it must sit on one line.

Two invite-window toasts still use the default (bottom) position: the 'has yet to respond to the first join request' warning in the RegisterPicker onPick (InviteCrewDialog.jsx ~line 185) and the 'Preview is only available after you tap Copy WhatsApp...' warning (~line 123). They could cover the Done button. Add TOP to them for consistency.

action_items: Optional: pass TOP ({position:'top-center'}) to the two remaining invite-window toasts (the waitingOn warning in onPick and the preview-unavailable warning).
Optional: check whether the Preview Invite bubble should stay on the same line as 'No reply yet' on 390px phones.
critical_code_review_comments: BoatPrep.jsx is 1395 lines, well over the 700-line guideline. The new crew hop/clone logic adds to it, so consider extracting the crew-prep clones row and the onCrewInvited listener into a hook or component.
onCrewInvited skips invites with no name (email-only invites get no Crew Prep clone), while CrewPrepCloneDialog may list them by email. Probably intended, but worth confirming.
Re-inviting an existing pending invitee with different roles replaces the invite (new invite_id, roles overwritten). This behaviour was already there and is not new, but worth knowing.
seed_data_creation: Temporary only: invites TEST_210 Alpha (WhatsApp) and TEST_210 Bravo (Quick Invite), register entry TEST_210 Bravo (quick-bulk), and clone lists 'Crew Prep - TEST_210 Alpha/Bravo'. All were removed: invites cancelled via API, register entry deleted, clone lists removed with it210_drop_clone.py (their ids added to deleted_lists), and the voyage_notes key the invite added was unset. Backup at /app/test_reports/backup/model_vessel_210.json.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Each browser_automation call is a fresh context, so localStorage (mbp_quick_role_selection) does not carry over between calls. Test persistence within one script. RegisterPicker: use 'button[data-testid^=invite-pick-]', because the plain prefix also matches the invite-pick-group-* div. The invite Done button may open invite-close-check, so click invite-close-check-close-btn. List delete (delete-list-btn) only shows on empty lists, so remove TEST clones with /app/tests/it210_drop_clone.py <list_id>. The Crew Roles list id on Model Vessel is tpl_9f5620bc49, so its hop testid is tpl_9f5620bc49-hop-route-btn.
